name: Trading System Status Report V 01
definition: The TradingSystemStatusReport message is sent by the Trading Venue to the Consolidated Tape Provider, which disseminates the data to their users on a consolidated basis. The TradingSystemStatusReport message provides the latest operational status of trading systems operated by each Trading Venue, indicating whether a system is active, experiencing an outage, or undergoing a partial outage.
